title: The Secret Detention
author: V. M. Eastwick
blurb: Coral Thackeray, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
